fields.title: Fiji ROC search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Field names mirror the upstream 'Buy Information' search grid verbatim (EntityName/EntityNumber/Type/Status/LegalElement). Fiji ROC's public search only exposes these summary fields -- the full entity profile (directors, shareholders, registered address, filing history, certificate download) sits behind a mandatory 'ROC Pass' OIDC login plus a paid purchase step on the source site, which is out of scope for this HTTP-only, no-login actor.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (entity number or entity name) that produced this record.

_searchBy.title: Search field used
_searchBy.description: entityNumber or entityName -- which upstream form field the query was sent as.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-buyinformation-search (real result row), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), result_set_too_broad (upstream silently caps very large result sets -- narrow the query), or blocked_or_transient (network/session issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

EntityName.title: Entity name
EntityName.description: Registered name of the company or business name, as held by ROC.

LegalElement.title: Legal element / suffix
LegalElement.description: Company suffix, e.g. LIMITED, PTE LIMITED, LTD, PTE LTD. Empty for business names (sole trader / partnership registrations).

EntityNumber.title: Entity number
EntityNumber.description: ROC company or business-name registration number, e.g. 10658 (company) or RCBS2015I10658 / 2026RB010658 (business name).

Type.title: Entity type
Type.description: COMPANY or BUSINESS NAME, as classified by ROC.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: Upstream register status, e.g. ACTIVE, CEASED, DE-REGISTERED.

entityDetailUrl.title: Full-profile URL (requires login)
entityDetailUrl.description: The upstream 'Buy Information' detail/purchase URL for this entity. Loading it redirects to auth.digital.gov.fj (ROC Pass OIDC login) -- NOT fetched by this actor, included only as a reference pointer.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for every search-result record.
